item.title: Trump’s made tariffs central to his presidency. Chaos may come next
item.description: President Donald Trump suffered a rare rebuke when the Supreme Court ruled against his tariff agenda. The decision Friday throws U.S. trade policy back into uncertainty. Trump has built his economic message around tariffs and the deals that he says they force. He argues they bring factories and jobs back. He also warns that losing them harms the economy.

item.title: Growing a garden doesn’t just feed yourself, it can build resilience and community connections
item.description: Salt Lake City residents can start a garden with the help of the Salt Lake City Library and the Community Food Microgrant Program.

item.title: Reggae the seal uses rubber ducks for daily enrichment training at Boston aquarium
item.description: It looks like pure play: a harbor seal gleefully chasing a rubber duck. But for Reggae at the New England Aquarium in Boston, the toy is part of a training routine meant to keep him learning.

item.title: Former Utah State basketball player pleads for return to US after arrest in Indonesia
item.description: Former Utah State basketball player Jarred Shaw pleads for a return to the US after arrest last May.

item.title: Man missing for nearly 2 weeks out of Moab, police say
item.description: The Grand County Sheriff’s Office has asked for the public’s help in locating a man who was last seen near Moab nearly two weeks ago.

item.title: Utah Supreme Court declines Legislature’s request to block new congressional map
item.description: A Utah Supreme Court panel denied the Legislature’s request to stay a district court ruling implementing a new congressional map.

item.title: Girl killed in Brighton Ski Resort avalanche identified as 11-year-old from Massachusetts
item.description: Police have identified the girl killed in Thursday’s avalanche as an 11-year-old from Massachusetts skiing with her family.

item.title: Bad Bunny positioned to consolidate his popularity in Brazil with first-ever performances
item.description: Bad Bunny performs in concert at the Allianz Parque stadium in Sao Paulo, Friday, Feb. 20, 2026.

item.title: Man dies in snowmobile accident near Iron Mine Mountain
item.description: According to the Wasatch County Sheriff's Office. a snowmobiler was found dead after what appeared to be a crash that trapped him under the vehicle.

item.title: No injuries reported after shots fired during fight on Salt Lake City sidewalk
item.description: No injuries were reported after the Salt Lake City Police Department responded to shots being fired Friday night during a fight involving several people, police said.
